explanation: The claim is that for every n, some convex set in ℝ^{n+2} has infinite VCₙ dimension. The file itself labels this "not in the literature". It is tagged `research solved`, but there is no citation and no linked proof, and the body is `sorry`, so I could not verify the solved status. The n = 0 case is trivial (by hasAddVCNDimAtMost_zero, any proper nonempty convex set works), and n = 1 follows from the ℝ³ result, but the general case is unsupported here. The mathematics is plausible; the issue is the unsubstantiated status.
